title: Chapter 237
text:
Thud thud thud!

Following the sound of footsteps, a group of people went up the stairs. The structure of the second floor was that the stairs were at the end. Surrounding the stairs were many doors, and there were bullet holes in the walls. Through the bullet holes, Han Xiao saw the IDs floating above the heads of these people.

Unlucky, it's a group of players.

He was wearing the Facial Simulator, so even if the players could not detect his real identity, they would at least be able to see that his attributes were a bunch of question marks, and they would immediately be on guard.

As the group of Germinal Organization players approached, their conversation could be heard.

"How many contribution points do you have?"

“127。”

"95. Killing refugees gives no contribution points. So annoying."

The players of the Six Nations and Germinal Organization had all received the battlefield mission. Killing players and characters of the opposing forces would give them contribution points. The war between factions should not have started at this stage, but Han Xiao had affected the storyline, causing the players to start fighting at a low level. They could only kill small fries, and their influence on the war was reduced to the minimum.

Bang! The door was kicked open, and the two players who were talking just now walked in. They looked around and saw Han Xiao standing in the corner.

"F * ck, another refugee." One of them raised his gun and was about to shoot without hesitation, as if he was dealing with an ant.

Whoosh!

A few sharp blades flew out and turned into a cold light, circling around the two players' necks. Blood spurted out, and the two players turned into white light and disappeared, killed instantly. These players were around LV 20 and had around 300 HP. The damage range of the purple Compounded Magnetic Chain Split Blades was 45-112, and their attack speed was extremely fast. Furthermore, with Han Xiao's LV 60 skills and talents, his Machinery Affinity was above 100 percent, and his Intelligence was also increased when using machinery. The damage he could deal was around three times the attributes of the machinery on the interface. Excluding the enemy's resistance reduction, killing players of this level in one or two hits was a piece of cake.

There were still a few players outside. Han Xiao put on the Electromagnetic Scanning Glasses and observed the position of the players through the walls. The floating blades pierced through the walls and slit the throats of these players. No one could react in time. The only thing they could remember before they died was the cold light that flashed past their eyes.

After taking care of all the enemies, Han Xiao curled his finger and put the Compounded Magnetic Chain Split Blades back into his sleeves like a bird returning to its nest.

After that, Han Xiao changed his face again and left the house quietly. He hid in the ruins and avoided the Germinal troops walking on the streets. He found a new house and continued to observe the outside world, waiting for an opportunity.

"I hope he's not a player again," Han Xiao mumbled.

…

Rays of white light flashed, and this group of players revived at the Germinal Organization's camp more than ten miles away. They were still in a daze, and their faces were full of confusion.

"How did I die?"

"Is there a bug?!"

Everyone hurriedly looked at the combat information on the interface.

[？？？ You received 275 damage.]

[？？？ You received 267 damage.]

[You were??? Kill]

All the players were confused.

Meow, meow, meow. What is this "???"?

…

Tu, tu, tu —

A series of bullets landed on the body of a Germinal Organization super soldier and hit the exoskeleton of the super soldier.

"This group of monsters is too tough." Fang Yun's face was ferocious. He threw away his gun and punched the super soldier's exoskeleton fist, leaving a dent.

The super soldier's strength was not comparable to a proper Super, but the Germinal Organization had improved the technology through a lot of experiments and could mass-produce super soldiers, which was a headache for the Six Nations on the battlefield.

Fang Yu and his team members surrounded the super soldier and quickly took him down. However, the sound of the battle attracted the attention of the Germinal Organization and other superhumans. A battle of encirclement started, and the scene was tragic. Blood was spilled everywhere.

The team members fell one by one. Fang Yun was surrounded by the Germinal Organization's super soldiers, and he was covered in wounds. He spat out blood as he moved, and his injuries were very serious.

A team member sacrificed himself to create a gap in the encirclement. Fang Yun rushed out without hesitation and escaped crazily. There were people chasing behind him.

Fang Yun could not remember whether he had escaped for ten or twenty minutes. His fatigue and injuries exploded. His legs gave way, and he fell down. He could not stand up and could only struggle to crawl.

Two Germinal Organization Supers followed him and walked toward Fang Yun with sinister smiles on their faces.

Fang Yun gritted his teeth. These two were the ones who had killed his team members.

There were buildings on both sides, and there were not many places to run. Fang Yun decided not to crawl and stared at the two of them, squeezing out his stamina to exchange for a little bit of energy to counterattack.

He was getting closer and closer. When he was only ten meters away, a figure suddenly appeared behind the two of them. However, the two of them did not notice and continued to walk forward.

Fang Yun was shocked. He saw that the person was dressed like a refugee.

"What happened?"

Sharp blades appeared beside the refugee, shining with a cold light. They cut the two of them from the back like butterflies, going back and forth a few times in the blink of an eye.

The two of them suddenly froze. The next second, more than ten wounds appeared on their bodies, and blood spurted out like water guns.

Fang Yun was shocked.

Two Germinal Organization Supers were killed by a refugee?

"You …"

Before he could say anything, the figure flashed in front of him. Then, Fang Yun's vision turned black, and he was knocked unconscious.

"Both of them are around LV 30." After looking at the combat information on the interface, Han Xiao was a little emotional. A long time ago, LV 30 was an insurmountable gap for him, but now, he could easily kill them.

The corpses were oozing blood like rotten bags, but Han Xiao purposely avoided touching their faces. In order not to delay his change of face, he first took out all the miscellaneous items on the two of them, including their IDs. He glanced at their names and then kept them.

He tapped his chin, and a triangular scanning beam shot out from between his eyebrows. It scanned the face of one of the corpses, and the face instantly became identical.

He took off the corpses' clothes and put them on himself. He heard the internal communication of the Germinal Organization through his earpiece. They were currently sweeping up the remaining Stardragon Warriors. Han Xiao thought for a while, set the two corpses on fire, and threw them aside. As for the Stardragon Warrior, he did not care about him.

Before Han Xiao went to meet up with the rest, a new message came in through his earpiece.

"Attention, attention, enemy reinforcements have arrived. There are Supers from Division 13."

"The enemy is too strong. Retreat immediately."

"Help, help, I'm in the west …"

Han Xiao's eyes flashed. This situation was perfect for him to sneak in.

Following the dense gunshots, Han Xiao came to the battlefield and found that the Germinal Organization was intercepted by Stardragon's reinforcements. The Supers from both sides were killing each other. Stardragon's Division 13 agents had the upper hand. The bullets from their guns would explode into flames after hitting the target. The threat was very high, and the Germinal Organization was obviously afraid of the consequences.

"High-explosive bullets?" Han Xiao's eyes flashed. He had not used up all the high-explosive bullets before leaving Stardragon?

He did not know that after he left, Division 13 had collected all the remaining high-explosive bullets. After burning three workshops to study the theory behind them, they were sealed as critical supplies and would only be given to the agents for key missions.

There were no familiar faces among the Division 13 agents, but Han Xiao vaguely remembered that he had met a few of them in Stardragon. He could not help but think of Li Yalin and the others. They must have been sent to the battlefield to do some mission, and he did not know if they were still alive. Thinking of this did not seem very optimistic. Or rather, he did not know if they were still alive.

A Germinal Organization Supers saw Han Xiao appear and hurriedly shouted, "Kareth, come and help!"

The unlucky guy Han Xiao replaced was called Kareth.

This shout attracted the attention of Stardragon's people, and the bullets flew toward him. Han Xiao cursed and quickly dodged. His reaction was fast enough, and the bullets chased after him, leaving behind a trail of fire on the ground.

He rarely used high-explosive bullets, and he did not expect Division 13 to still use them. They were all leftovers.

Han Xiao did not want to fight, but trouble came looking for him. A Stardragon agent turned around to deal with him. His whole body was covered in flames, and he charged forward with an unstoppable momentum. He pulled out a hilt and a retractable blade. It was the retractable blade that Han Xiao had once made.

"Yo, a dancer." Han Xiao curled his finger, and the Compounded Magnetic Chain Split Blades flew out. In an instant, the Pugilist's thigh was cut open, and he fell flat on his face. Han Xiao rushed over and kicked him away. He crashed into an off-road vehicle, and the vehicle flipped over. This person would probably be bedridden for at least half a year.

The Germinal Organization soldier who shouted Han Xiao's name was dumbfounded.

When did Kareth become so strong all of a sudden?

Just as he was about to call for Han Xiao's help, he saw Han Xiao knock away the people blocking the road, jump into a vehicle, and escape without saying anything.

The Germinal Organization people were stunned, but they quickly reacted and jumped into their vehicles to escape. Since the situation was not good, once someone took the lead, others would follow.

…

The troops escaped back to the temporary camp, and the officer immediately went forward to ask. The Germinal Organization soldiers, who were covered in dust, hurriedly explained the situation. Han Xiao pretended to be anxious and said a few words, but no one suspected him. More accurately, no one had the time to suspect him. The temporary camp was very busy, and after the officer heard the explanation, he immediately ordered the other troops to carry out other tasks.
